reuse.why: Gets its categories from the existing getMonthWideCategories selection and reuses getSheetValue/sum-amount, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator(undoable(...)) registration.

duplication.why: The income/tracking-mode skip is repeated, but every existing month-wide action already does that check inline; the new code copies nothing larger.

placement.why: Action in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions, registered in budget/app.ts next to them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its neighbours; the sign handling (Math.max(-net, 0)) differs a little from the averages' `*= -1` convention but is clear.
